subject: Transportation Systems
title: Angle of Attack
description: Learn Angle of Attack in one minute.

hook.text: Tilt a wing upward and it generates more lift. Tilt too far and it suddenly stops flying.

buildup.text: The angle between the wing and oncoming air is called the angle of attack.

discovery.text: A steeper angle forces more air downward, increasing lift—up to a critical point.

twist.text: Past about 15 degrees, airflow separates from the wing surface. Lift collapses. That's a stall.

climax.text: Stall recovery is one of the first things pilots learn. Nose down, gain speed, restore airflow.

punchline.text: Too much angle kills the very thing that keeps you up.

quiz.question: What happens when the angle of attack is too steep?
options: Airflow separates and lift collapses—a stall
